headline: Accepted $6,000 offer from Brett Benincasa for Lots 6, 7 & 8 Witches Rock Road, to merge with his property.
summary: Discussion covered Perkins Street parcels, a lease with the Bristol Burlington Health District, and several other city properties. Two neighbors spoke about the Witches Rock Road lots, and Brett Benincasa said he would submit a counteroffer if the property could be developed. Some other properties were reported as conveyed or closed.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 5, 2026 regular meeting, 3-0.
Approved meeting schedule for 2027: first Monday of each month at 5:30 p.m., with Tuesday meetings when the first Monday is a holiday, 3-0.
Accepted Brett Benincasa's $6,000 offer for Lots 6, 7 & 8 Witches Rock Road, to be merged with his property with a deed restriction against subdividing, 3-0.

plain_text:
Page 1 
 
 
City of Bristol 
BRISTOL, CONNECTICUT  06010 
 
REAL ESTATE COMMITTEE 
MINUTES 
MEETING OF MONDAY, NOVEMBER 2, 2026 
5:30 P.M. 
CALL TO ORDER: 
By: Chairman Hahn Time: 5:30 p.m. Place: City Hall 
111 North Main Street 
Meeting Room 1-1 
 
NAME PRESENT ABSENT 
Councilman Greg Hahn, Chairperson X  
Councilman Erick Rosengren X  
Councilman Mark Dickau X  
 
Also in attendance:  Nancy Haynes, Jeffrey Steeg, Maria Theam, Derrick Ruegg, Brett Benincasa, Tyler 
Stevens (Zoom) 
1.    Administrative Matters  
 
a.    Approval of Minutes – October 5, 2026 Regular Meeting 
MOTION:    To approve the minutes of the Regular Meeting of October 5, 2026. 
BY:    Councilman Dickau          Seconded: Councilman Rosengren 
For:    All in favor   None Opposed.  Motion Carries. 
 b. Set Schedule of Regular Meetings for 2027  
Discussion was held regarding the meeting schedule. It was agreed that meetings would 
continue to be held on the first Monday of each month at 5:30 p.m. In the event that the 
first Monday falls on a holiday, the meeting will be held the following day, Tuesday, at 
5:30 p.m. 
BY:    Councilman Dickau          Seconded: Councilman Rosengren 
For:    All in favor    None Opposed.  Motion Carries. 
2.    Public Participation – No one appeared for public participation.   
3.    New Business – No new business. 
4.    Old Business 
a.    Parcel 19-10 Perkins Street – Status  An appraisal of the property has been 
completed, with an appraised value of $42,000. The appraisal was forwarded to Attorney
Page 2 
Ziogas and outside counsel, Attorney Rick Goodine. The title search remains pending 
and is anticipated to be completed within the next couple of weeks. 
b.    Parcel 16-3 Perkins Street – Discussion was held regarding the City’s right of first 
refusal and the Planning Commission’s negative referral concerning the proposed waiver 
of that right. Attorney Steeg provided an overview of the email correspondence 
exchanged between Attorney Ziogas and the Mayor. Further discussion ensued. 
c.    99 Main Street - Status  
Recorded deed and map.   
 
d.    Lease with the (BBHD) Bristol Burlington Health District (BEALS Senior 
Community Center) Discussion ensued about the lease.   
 
e.    81 Church Avenue – Closing tentatively scheduled for Wednesday 11/4/2026.   
f.    Lots 6,7 & 8 Witches Rock Road  - Two interested neighboring property owners 
were present for this portion of the agenda. Mr. Derrick Ruegg addressed the 
Committee, stating that he resides across the street from the property and has no 
immediate plans to develop it. 
Mr. Brett Benincasa appeared before the Committee once again and also addressed the 
Committee and expressed his willingness to submit a counteroffer in response to Mr. 
Ruegg’s higher offer if it was determined that the property could be developed on.   
Discussion ensued regarding the potential future use and development of the property. 
MOTION:    To accept the offer from Brett Benincasa for $6,000 to be merged with his 
property with a deed restriction that it cannot be subdivided.   
BY:    Councilman Rosengren          Seconded: Councilman Dickau 
For:    All in favor 
 
None Opposed.  Motion Carries. 
 
g.    List of possible encroaching property owners on city owner property 
i. 64 Kilmartin – Attorney Steeg talked about the blight issues.  
ii.  93 Tuttle Road – Status- Done.  Property was conveyed, Ms. Cockayne paid and 
she was reportedly happy with the end result.   
h. Lots 4&6 (aka 164) Union St – Woman who expressed interest has not gotten back to 
Atty Steeg.   No other interest from anyone else.   
i.  135 East Main Street - Status 
Closed on this property. 
5.    Adjournment 
 
MOTION:    To adjourn the meeting at 6:08pm 
 
BY:    Councilman Rosengren          Seconded: Councilman Dickau 
For:    All in favor 
None Opposed.  Motion Carries.
